args:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Token usage thresholds (10%, 20%, 30%, etc.)
THRESHOLDS=(10 20 30 40 50 60 70 80 90)
TOKEN_TRACKER="${HOME}/.claude/projects/$(pwd | md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1)/token_tracker.json"
MARKER_DIR="${HOME}/.claude/token_markers"

mkdir -p "$MARKER_DIR" "$(dirname "$TOKEN_TRACKER")"

# Try to estimate usage from session context
# This is a simplified approach - actual implementation would need Claude Code integration
if [ -f "$TOKEN_TRACKER" ]; then
  CURRENT_USAGE=$(jq '.usage_percent // 0' "$TOKEN_TRACKER" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
else
  CURRENT_USAGE=0
  echo '{"usage_percent": 0}' > "$TOKEN_TRACKER"
fi

# Check if we've crossed any thresholds
for threshold in "${THRESHOLDS[@]}"; do
  marker_file="${MARKER_DIR}/.threshold_${threshold}"
  
  if [ $CURRENT_USAGE -ge $threshold ] && [ ! -f "$marker_file" ]; then
    echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"⚠️  Token usage reached ${threshold}% of session budget\"}" | jq -c .
    touch "$marker_file"
  fi
done
